get_fsm_entity_history: get the state history of an FSM entity by entity name and entity ID
trigger_fsm_entity_transition: trigger a state transition on an FSM entity with transition name and optional data
filter_fsm_history_by_date_range: filter FSM entity state history by created_at_from and created_at_to ISO 8601 dates
order_fsm_history_by_id: order FSM entity state history results by ID ascending or descending
check_fsm_entity_permissions: check required permissions for FSM entity history and transition API access
